## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve brand, authored CMS content, business records and payment/auth safeguards.
- Use existing provider configurations and verify responsive reflow.

### Avoid

- Invented endorsements, stock, campaigns or rankings; unlicensed reference assets.
- Automatic third-party translation of private URLs.

## Decisions

- 9 November booking-first refinement: magenta #c60073 leads shared controls,
  blush surfaces, violet #5b21b6/cyan #10cddd accents and small gold #ffd23f
  highlights. Centred Home between Events/Tickets and Book/Contact. Branded
  host portraits, colour welcome card, semantic service bullets, eligible real
  poster and owned video below cards; gentle reduced-motion-aware interaction.

- 9 November host-art addition: Lucy wears a plain black T-shirt behind Eugine
  in the mobile hero. Use the generated owned-source two-host cutout, keep both
  faces visible at320–430px and retain the Contact tab/Android viewport repair.

- 9 November Android correction: heading scales against the normalized phone
  viewport, intro stays in flow and short-screen card actions clear the dock.
  Remove the GANG dot and add a fifth Contact destination. Keep the light header,
  owned portrait, existing desktop UI and commerce safeguards.

- 9 November: the owner-selected Eventify mobile reference (Dribbble27650927)
  supersedes the older no-dock phone design. Mobile website/PWA use bold
  black/magenta type, owned-host editorial artwork, mint action strips, rounded
  black navigation and dark event/ticket panels. Preserve the light shared
  header, real records, six languages and transaction/entitlement safeguards.
  Desktop remains MOOKH/Nixtio; shop-specific catalogue/mannequins remain intact.

- 1 November completion: shop follows the captured Mkurugenzi landscape banner,
  collection-photo browsing, white rounded five-desktop/one-phone product grid
  and locally hosted Poppins/Playfair/Bebas typography. Five standalone black-apparel mannequin studio
  illustrations replace flat defaults; other selected colours retain accurate
  existing previews. Keep UGT branding, real catalogue and active payment setup.

- 1 November: Mkurugenzi-grounded public storefront structure, adapted to UGT
  identity and compact spacing. Search/cart masthead, module/story microcards,
  embedded collection and magenta mobile actions replace the long homepage
  sequence. Only existing configured payment methods may be offered; no UI
  treatment overrides the Paystack activation gates or server-priced checkout.
- 27 October: MOOKH-inspired public surfaces in warm stone/cream/ink with UGT
  magenta, yellow and cyan accents. Homepage video/poster crop conceals branded
  edges; a restrained charcoal scrim keeps copy prominent without blur or colour filters. Existing
  flows, authored content, media masters, accessibility and document printing stay.
